intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Saint Paul for 2026, and here is what he found: 22 family events, 9 of them free, including the Union Depot trains and markets, plus neighbors Falcon Heights, Mendota Heights and Maplewood. The magic runs from November 28 (Holidays on the Hill at the James J. Hill House) through January 3, 2027, with Santa's Train Shop at the Jackson Street Roundhouse (December 5 to 20), Breakfast with Santa at The Saint Paul Hotel (December 5) and the Minnesota Merry Market (December 5 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Saint Paul

  • 22 Christmas events for kids in Saint Paul (6 already live, 8 moved from Minneapolis, 8 new), including Falcon Heights, Mendota Heights and Maplewood
  • Free: Santa visits and kids activities at the Minnesota Merry Market, and the European Christmas Market at Union Depot
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at The Saint Paul Hotel (December 5, $45 and $25), Vis the Season in Mendota Heights (December 5) and Holiday with Santa in Maplewood (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Tree Lighting and Movie Night at Union Depot (December 5)
  • Trains: Santa's Train Shop and Caboose Rides, the North Pole Express and the CPKC Holiday Train at Union Depot
  • Season: November 28 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Saint Paul families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers Shine On Minneapolis on Nicollet Mall, the Christkindl Market, holiday shows at Orchestra Hall and the State Theatre, and trolley rides on the Como-Harriet line.
